PREFIX brick: <brick:>
PREFIX ref: <ref:>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999-02-22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?z ?zlabel ?sensor ?sclass ?series WHERE {
  ?zone rdf:type brick:Zone .
  ?zone rdfs:label ?zlabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(?zlabel, "F3_Z01") || CONTAINS(?zlabel, "Core_mid"))
  OPTIONAL {
    ?sensor brick:hasMonitor ?zone .
    ?sensor rdf:type ?sclass .
    ?sensor ref:hasTimeseriesId ?series .
  }
}

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick/ref#>
SELECT ?s ?cls ?series WHERE {
  ?s rdf:type ?cls .
  ?s ref:hasTimeseriesId ?series .
  ?s brick:isPointOf ?equip .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(STR(?s), "Z01"))
}
LIMIT 60

A sensor drift (+2°C bias) is fully consistent with this (controller over-cools to hold true temp at setpoint); a genuine local load increase followed by more cooling is also consistent. No independent zone measurement, no airflow/thermal power, no thermostat data exists to break the degeneracy.
